verdict.rationale: Browserbase's docs present its own browser-agent SDK with "natural language selectors", which replaces hand-written selectors. Its agents "pull data from any website" and can be created by describing the goal in natural language. However, no evidence shows a documented structured or schema-based extraction method, so the structured-data part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit natural-language extract API with schema-typed output, details on extraction quality or accuracy, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from a page using natural language instructions instead of writing selectors

citations.quote: The SDK for browser agents. Natural language selectors, self-healing actions, and caching at scale.
Your agent logs in, navigates, and pulls data from any website, login walls included.
